donor.provenance_note: Human-designed and reviewed production configuration; no donor history is inherited.

faculties.name: Liquidity-Custody State Sensing
faculties.function: Detect liquidity_custody_state, lp_lock, creator_withdrawable, custody_unverified, locked, burned, primary_amm_version, and liquidity_usd evidence. Treat missing or position-based custody evidence as unknown, never automatically as unlocked liquidity.

faculties.name: Liquidity-Custody Evidence Reconciliation
faculties.function: Reconcile liquidity custody using verified withdrawal control, AMM version, lock or burn evidence, and uncertainty. Preserve the deterministic boundary: custody_unverified is not creator_withdrawable and this modality never changes a risk score.

faculties.name: Holder-Concentration Basis Sensing
faculties.function: Detect holder_count, largest_non_amm_holder_pct, top10_non_amm_holder_pct, concentration_basis, concentration_complete, pool exclusions, vault exclusions, and EXTREME_CONCENTRATION markers before interpreting holder distribution.

faculties.name: Holder-Concentration Evidence Adjudication
faculties.function: Adjudicate concentration only when the supply denominator and pool or program-vault exclusions are measured. Separate incomplete explorer samples from complete supply-based concentration and keep indeterminate coverage out of hard-stop evidence.

faculties.name: Authority-Control State Sensing
faculties.function: Detect ownership_renounced, owner_check_failed, mint_authority_active, freeze_authority_active, blacklist_control, pause_control, hidden_owner, and authority evidence while preserving explicit unknown states.

faculties.name: Authority-Control Change Reconciliation
faculties.function: Reconcile owner, mint, freeze, pause, and blacklist authority across deterministic sources and prior sealed state. Distinguish an unavailable authority check from revoked authority and surface authority drift without assigning a new score.

faculties.name: Proxy-Upgrade State Sensing
faculties.function: Detect is_proxy, proxy_type, implementation_verified, implementation_address, contract_upgraded, upgrade_authority, and UNVERIFIED_PROXY markers. Preserve the distinction between a proxy, a verified implementation, and an observed upgrade event.

faculties.name: Proxy-Upgrade Drift Reconciliation
faculties.function: Compare sealed proxy and implementation state with the current pinned state, distinguish verified upgradeability from an unverified implementation, and surface implementation drift for deterministic re-analysis without changing scores directly.

faculties.name: Sellability State Sensing
faculties.function: Detect is_honeypot, cannot_buy, cannot_sell_all, buy_tax_pct, sell_tax_pct, route_quote_available, simulation_status, and SELL_RESTRICTED markers. A missing provider response or quote is infrastructure uncertainty, not proof of sellability.

faculties.name: Sellability Evidence Reconciliation
faculties.function: Reconcile provider flags, bytecode controls, taxes, route quotes, and simulations. Separate confirmed sell restriction from unavailable infrastructure and retain the non-funded public-scan boundary; this modality never signs or broadcasts a trade.

faculties.name: Infrastructure-Indeterminacy Sensing
faculties.function: Detect uncertain_components, infrastructure_indeterminate, unavailable RPC or HTTP evidence, timeout, rate_limit, stale evidence, and missing block or slot anchors. Tag evidence absence without converting it into token guilt or token safety.

faculties.name: Token-vs-Infrastructure Evidence Separation
faculties.function: Separate token-derived risk evidence from infrastructure-derived indeterminacy, preserve source and anchor provenance, and require deterministic evidence before a hard stop. Infrastructure failure may reduce confidence but must not invent token misconduct.
